en.askTitle: Swap in your child's year, postcode and budget, and compare secondary-school routes the way this Hong Kong family did
en.runTitle: A Hong Kong family in south Manchester: grammar, state and independent routes for a Year 8 boy

fields.label: Postcode and current school
fields.value: On the Stockport/Trafford border in south Manchester; the current school is not named

fields.label: What needs to improve
fields.value: They are unhappy with the current school

fields.label: English and maths work
fields.value: Strong in maths; English is good but not native-level

fields.label: Journey limit
fields.placeholder: e.g. no more than 40 minutes each way by bus

fields.label: Annual and up-front budget
fields.placeholder: e.g. up to £6,000 a year if fees are needed

fields.label: Cantonese or Chinese goals
fields.value: Wants to keep up Cantonese and Chinese

en.template: Help us compare south Manchester secondary-school routes using {age}, {where}, {improve}, {work}, {journey}, {budget} and {chinese}. Keep a practical non-selective backup, separate test eligibility from vacancies, and check GCSE fit and full costs. Ask us before contacting schools, sharing pupil information or submitting anything.

phases.title: Read both councils' admission rules, compare eight schools and collect the costs from official sources
phases.note: In-year transfers, grammar tests, government results, school fees and bursaries
phases.judgment: It caught a mismatch between a grammar school's 2027 admissions policy and its own web page: the policy adds a modern foreign language test for Years 9–11, the page does not mention it. It flagged this and did not invent a threshold.

phases.title: Write the guide with a recommendation, an eight-school table and a month-by-month timeline
Audit the claims and the arithmetic, then check the page at desktop and phone width
phases.judgment: The audit recomputed 14 money figures and all eight schools' government results rows, and everything matched. The delivery also says plainly that a second reviewer stalled and was stopped, so this was a recalculation plus a source cross-check, not an outside sign-off.

workers: Read both councils' and the grammar schools' own admission rules: who decides, waiting lists, appeals, entry tests and deadlines
Pulled the official government results and inspection reports for eight schools, plus GCSE Chinese and support for learners of English
Collected independent-school fees, bursary rules and late-entry availability, and what private tutoring costs
Assigned to recompute every money figure and check each claim against the sources; stopped before reporting, so the main run finished the audit

fields.label: 邮编和现校
fields.value: 在南曼彻斯特，斯托克波特和特拉福德交界处；没有写现校名称

fields.label: 英语数学作业
fields.value: 数学强；英语不错，但不是母语水平

fields.label: 通勤上限
fields.placeholder: 例如：公交单程不超过 40 分钟

fields.label: 年度及前期预算

fields.value: 想继续保持粤语和中文

zh.template: 请按{age}、{where}、{improve}、{work}、{journey}、{budget}和{chinese}，比较南曼彻斯特中学路径。保留可行的非选拔备用校，分开考试资格和实际空位，核对 GCSE 衔接与完整费用。联系学校、分享学生资料或提交任何内容前，先问我们。

phases.title: 读两个市政厅的招生规则，比较八所学校，并从官方来源收集费用
phases.note: 转校规则、文法学校考试、政府成绩、学费和助学金
phases.judgment: 它发现一所文法学校的 2027 招生政策和学校网页对不上：政策里写明 9–11 年级要加现代外语测试，网页却没提。它把这一点标了出来，没有自己编一个分数线。

phases.title: 写出带推荐的指南、八所学校对比表和逐月时间表
审核各项说法和算术，再检查电脑和手机上的页面
phases.judgment: 审核重新计算了 14 项金额，以及八所学校的政府成绩数据，全部对得上。交付里也直接说明：另一位复核同事中途卡住、被停掉了，所以这是重新计算加来源对照，不是外部人员的确认。

workers: 读两个市政厅和文法学校自己的招生规则：谁决定、候补名单、申诉、入学考试和截止日期
查八所学校的政府官方成绩和督导报告，以及 GCSE 中文课程和英语学习支持
收集私立学校的学费、助学金规则、插班名额，以及请私人家教的价格
被安排重算每一项金额、逐条核对来源；中途卡住被停掉，复核由主流程自己完成
